topic: Beneficial and harmful interactions among living things
key_concepts: Organisms interact with one another and depend on these interactions for survival
Interactions among living things can be beneficial or harmful
An ecosystem includes all living and non-living things in a given area
Ecology is the study of relationships and interactions of living things with one another a
Mutualism is an interaction where both species benefit
Commensalism is an interaction where one organism benefits while the other is not harmed n
Predation is an interaction where a predator benefits and the prey is harmed
Predator and prey population sizes are related
Parasitism is a relationship where a parasite benefits and the host is harmed
Parasites can be internal or external and must live in a living host
Competition is the striving or vying between organisms for things needed for survival
Examples include butterfly-flower mutualism, orchids on a tree commensalism, frog-mosquito
